key_insight: Dynamic transformation of 1-acetylpiperazine (PX) couples crystallization control with interface passivation in lead-free tin-based perovskite solar cells.
engineering_relevance: A single additive could simplify materials processing while improving film quality, photovoltaic efficiency, and operational stability.
method: Coordinate PX carbonyl groups with Sn²⁺ to stabilize precursor complexes and control crystal growth.
Anneal films to induce PX transformation, suggested to produce amidinium-functionalized species.
Passivate surface A-site vacancies with transformed species to suppress nonradiative recombination.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 15.18% power conversion efficiency and retention of 94.1% of initial efficiency after 500 hours of continuous illumination.
watch_item: The transformed species are only tentatively identified, and the abstract does not specify device area or illumination-test conditions.
paper_title: Dynamic Molecular Transformation Mediated Crystallization Regulation and Interface Passivation in Tin Based Perovskite Solar Cells
